candidates.title: macOS: source, map and keyboard usability

metadata.scope: Human interaction judgment only; not whole-card or platform-matrix acceptance

criteria: At your normal Retina display setting, is the selected review.cpp source comparison, its single correspondence map, and the visible keyboard focus usable and legible?
candidates.content: This is the actual tests-disabled universal candidate, not a mockup. The closed local GitHub CLI fixture supplies only synthetic octo-reviewer/review-repository data and cannot publish. Run the command, choose Use GitHub CLI, accept the fixture read consent, paste the supplied link and choose Start review. Expected source: earlier values 11–16, later values 21–26; one replacement map and one shared comparison position. Focus the map, press Return, then Tab into source. Inspect your normal window/display size; record an issue if focus, layout or text is unclear. Quit with Command-Q when finished. The bounded launcher allows five minutes; rerun it if needed. Do not choose device sign-in, add a server, or open another repository. Acceptance answers only this question; real-vault cleanup, clean-account authentication and other platforms remain pending.

candidates.title: macOS: maintenance scope and confirmation clarity

metadata.scope: Human interaction judgment only; not whole-card or platform-matrix acceptance

criteria: Do the diagnostic-preview, profile-retirement confirmation and post-retirement messages make their local scope, cancellation behavior and next action clear?
candidates.content: This separate disposable profile contains no real credentials. Run the command. Open Settings, select Storage & privacy, and Preview diagnostics. Inspect the local-only/export disclosure. Choose Prepare diagnostic cleanup: Cancel is the default; cancel once, then prepare again if you want to inspect the retired-profile state. Preparation closes the review window but deletes nothing. Optional clearing affects only this disposable fixture's diagnostics. Command-Q must still quit while Settings remains open. The full-profile purge buttons are deliberately unavailable because this isolated HOME has no default Keychain; do not approve that missing capability. The launcher allows five minutes and can be rerun. Do not configure real sign-in. This decision covers wording and interaction clarity only, not actual credential deletion or the entire card.
